scene.line: On a cold, blustery night, just like tonight IT HAPPENED!
OH NO! What happened??
I had just finished helping Tink recycle
all of the funny looking items,
That had washed up on Palm Tree Cove...
...and we had a lot of new furniture to make when we realized...
...we had run out of Meadow Grass...
...and desperately needed more.
A storm was just about to hit the Hollow,
So we flew here to Chilly Falls...
...as fast as our wings could take us.
Right when we got here...
...we began looking for more Meadow Grass,
But all of a sudden there was a terrible CRASH!!!
Aaaaahhhh!!!!! Wh..wh..what was the noise?
A huge pile of sticks had fallen over near Never Mine,
But this wasn't a random pile of sticks.
Someone...or something had tried making a shelter.
Was it an animal that hadn't made it to Drowsy Den?
I sure hope so!
We had no idea!
Whatever it was,
It didn't sound like critters we'd heard before.
What did it sound like??
BOO! BOOOOO! Booo hoooo
We're scared!
We were scared too, but we had to find out what this was.
So we flew closer and closer...and CLOSER...
Only to find a crying and very frightened garden-talent pixie!
She had just arrived to the Hollow that day and lost her way.
How did she get lost?
She had ran into a big group of fairies in Dewdrop Vale
Who had been in Pixie Hollow for a long time.
And well, they didn't feel like showing a new Fairy around.
So she flew around for a while,
And ended up in Chilly Falls when the storm hit.
She tried making a shelter...
When she heard us rustling through the pines, got scared...
...And that's when you found her!
That's right! We took her to her new home.
And on a tour of Pixie Hollow the next day.
Today she knows the Hollow like the back of her wings,
From every dewdrop to every tree!
She and her friends sold the map at Ember's shop...
...so no other fairy would ever get lost again.
Remember, no matter how long you've been a part of the Hollow,
Don't ever be too busy to help out a new pixie.
We won't!
